name: Go-Virtual Self-Hosted OpenAPI Mock Server
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted OpenAPI 3 mock server with manual responses, templating, proxy recording, Starlark scripts, session state, tracing and an admin UI; no vendor-imposed request quota or expiry.
watch_out: Requires your own compute and storage. Optional AI response generation may incur third-party model API charges; protect the admin interface and captured request data before public exposure.
